text: "Let us break apart their [divine] bands [of restraint] And cast away their cords [of control] from us."
"Yet as for Me, I have anointed and firmly installed My King Upon Zion, My holy mountain."
'You shall break them with a rod of iron; You shall shatter them [in pieces] like earthenware.'"

Kiss (pay respect to) the Son, so that He does not become angry, and you perish in the way, For His wrath may soon be kindled and set aflame. How blessed [fortunate, prosperous, and favored by God] are all those who take refuge in Him!
